title: The Story of VS Code | Official Documentary
original_title: The Story of VS Code | Official Documentary
overview: Erich Gamma once said that VS Code was an overnight success that took 10 years in the making. Those 10 years were quite intense.  Before becoming one of the most widely used development tools in the world, VS Code started with a small team creating online developer tools out of Zurich. It was called Monaco, then Visual Studio Online Monaco, then Ticino (why not?), became a desktop editor, went open source, grew into an ecosystem of its own, returned to the browser, and helped establish a whole bunch of open protocols along the way.  And just when it seemed like the hardest part was over, AI arrived.  This is the story of how VS Code got here, told by the people who built it and the developers who helped shape it. And now, how it's adapting once again as AI transforms the very concept of a code editor.

title: The Taste of Pineapple Bread

Despite his small size and limited experience, his determination catches the attention of a boxing coach, who teaches him that being a fighter is not only about physical strength, but also discipline, patience, courage, and heart.  As Joi prepares for the biggest fight of his life, he must overcome fear, pressure, and self-doubt. Through his journey, he discovers that the most important opponent is not the person standing across the ring, but himself.  Born for the Ring is a story about family, sacrifice, perseverance, and the true meaning of victory.

title: The Copycat Killer

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Black Knights
overview: A short documentary exploring the lives, deep friendship, and resilience of six Black West Point graduates against the backdrop of America's War on Terror. Filmed remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic and the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, the film blends intimate remote interviews, archival military footage, presidential speeches, and personal photos. It chronicles their time at the United States Military Academy, deployments to Iraq, Afghanistan, Kuwait, and South Korea, and transitions into successful civilian careers and graduate school. Notably, the documentary highlights the group's diversity by embracing its LGBTQ+ members. By celebrating profound male bonds, Black Knights challenges traditional narratives and preconceived notions about who serves in the U.S. military and what military service means for America.

After cutting ties with her toxic sister, Elyse retreats to her ancestral home to rebuild her mental health. But her journey toward healing is derailed when a grotesque creature begins to stalk her. It feeds on her emotional turmoil, forcing her to confront the past she tried to escape or lose herself and those she loves.

Where do I belong?  Decades later, Ward returns to South Korea with his family to confront the culture he once resented and the sacrifices his mother made. What begins as a personal pilgrimage becomes a reckoning with history and a mission to change the lives of children who now walk the path he once did.

It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

title: The Man in the Second Story Window
original_title: The Man in the Second Story Window
overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

title: Laniakea the creature (in super 8 Ektachrome)
overview: the zany and lovable Laniakea doesnt know what type of creature she is, or if she is even real. She finds help from Glaucous the creature, Joy the creature, and Miss Mousey Mouse Church Mouse the Mouse.  featuring the wondrous nature of ohio, the luminous spectrum of kodak ektachrome super 8 film stock, and a brainwave swirling synthesizer based soundtrack  DESTROY ALL LEAFBLOWERS

title: Motel Inn
overview: Daniel has worked at a motel for years. He has seen a range of strange guests enter and leave; these four have been the strangest.

title: Dagnabbit!
overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.

title: People on Trial
overview: Sadiq Uliyil revisits the history of the legal struggle and solidarity that emerged for Zakariya’s release,  a native of Parappanangadi who has spent 17 years in prison as an undertrial. As the trial continues to drag on, the film captures the silent suffering endured by a man and his family, particularly his mother, and the unbearable burden of waiting.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: Better Days
overview: Feature film directed by Hamza Pool, currently in post-production, style and plot kept under wraps.

title: A Walk in the Park
overview: A secret agent faces unexpected obstacles during a time-sensitive mission.

title: Hollow Trees
overview: Years after a devastating war, a hardened survivor and a young boy are forced from their home by a creature capable of imitating humans. As they journey north in search of refuge, their fragile bond is pushed to its limits.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: Far from Maine
overview: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

title: Taming the Beast
overview: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

title: The Campaign
overview: The Campaign dives into how this is not just a war of rockets and gunfire, but one of narratives: a global effort to shape public perception around Gaza, Israel, the West, and the Jewish people. It’s a war fought through propaganda, disinformation, and emotional manipulation, amplified by both mainstream and social media.

title: Mantle of Dusk
overview: From the mouth of the mad river.

title: Wet Paper Bag
overview: A former investigative journalist goes undercover at a psychedelic wellness center to find her missing sister. What she uncovers is far more unsettling than she expected.  Wet Paper Bag is a psychological drama that explores identity, control, and the quiet tension beneath carefully constructed lives.

title: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure
overview: An astonishing award-winning documentary that goes beyond asking whether extraterrestrial contact is real - and into the more unsettling question of why, drawing on firsthand accounts and evidence for what intelligent life beyond our world may be.

title: Homage
overview: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

title: Blowfish
overview: A drifting young high school dropout gets himself employed at a suburban fish store, where he decides to steal a rare and valuable pufferfish that will help him start his life afresh. In his efforts to sell the precious item to a wealthy collector, the scheme begins to deteriorate into paranoia, dangerous situations, and unhealthy relationships. When faced with the results of his dishonesty, he must confront himself and understand the true consequences of his actions.

title: The World Is Our Dance Floor
original_title: The World Is Our Dance Floor
overview: Exactly one year after a tragedy, a young writer carries on through the night as though it were any other. What first appears ordinary gradually reveals itself as something far more fragile.

title: Hope
overview: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

title: Squander
overview: Comprised of all still photographs, a film exploring a persons isolation and mental deterioration.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: Motivated by his sister's disappearance, a man sneaks into the seemingly perfect town of Gloomshade Grove, only to reveal its chilling secret that holds the community together.

title: Dinamita
overview: After a harsh breakup, a soul-crushing job, and the pain of watching her ex move on with someone new, Cristina reaches a breaking point. What starts as a fleeting intrusive thought turns into a wild, reckless plan to erase him from her life — a choice that will send her down a path with no way back.

title: Greektown Wrestling 5.29.16
overview: Canada's rowdiest independent promotion is back to blow the roof off the building as Greektown Wrestling presents its massive May 29th blockbuster, streaming live and on-demand worldwide on TrillerTV+. Packed with deathmatch icons, international stars, and a highly anticipated war inside the steel structure, this event promises a classic, chaotic night of elite independent wrestling.

title: Mystery Wrestling #25.5
overview: Mystery Wrestling #25.5 aired May 29, 2026

title: Hard To Notice
overview: As Itay prepares for his mandatory military service, his sister’s intimate lens captures a family on the edge. What starts as a bittersweet portrait of parental anxiety takes a dramatic turn when frustration leads Itay to a suicide attempt in his military base. Through raw, uncensored conversations, and with the healing power of the camera, the family is forced to confront years of denial, finally discovering the truth: Itay is autistic. A moving journey from alienation to acceptance, showing how one diagnosis can transform a “broken” young man into a person finally seen for who he truly is.

title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
original_title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
overview: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...

title: Whores of Horror
overview: A young and curious whore explorer travels through the land of floptropica to find the kinds of whores that roam around the land.

title: GNAW!
overview: A surrealist short following the 'timeless' hunter on his eternal prowl.

title: Where the Black Dog Runs
overview: As a rural village prepares for its final harvest festival as a luxury building development is greenlit, an ancient threat awakens and Julian must come face to face with a haunting piece of folklore.

title: The Misconceived
overview: A failed filmmaker turned single dad tries to make a living while retaining his sense of self, in James N. Kienitz Wilkins’ experimental 3D-rendered home renovation comedy, which doubles as an acidic treatise on working conditions for the contemporary creative.

title: The Narrative
overview: As long as Kweku Adoboli is making millions for UBS in London, his future seems golden. But when the young trader takes responsibility for a $2.3 billion loss, the narrative shifts dramatically.

title: Lure
overview: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

title: Thus Spoke the Late
overview: A recently deceased denial-ridden young woman—wanders through a familiar park to confront the man of her past and the manifestation of the doctor who failed her, seeking to fully let go of her worldly self.

title: True Love and Wormholes
overview: Maggie’s from the West Country; Craig’s from the Future - and together they might just save the planet. But should she take a chance on the handsome man with the far-out backstory? Or is she just desperate for a connection? As their bond deepens, the danger escalates, smashing the boundaries between reality and delusion, science and possibility, betrayal and True Love.

title: What We Said to Brussels Airlines
original_title: What We Said to Brussels Airlines
overview: One hundred years after the first flight between Belgium and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Brussels Airlines approaches Collectif Faire-Part with a proposal to show their work on board their flights. Interwoven with archival footage and testimonies of activists and survivors of in-flight violence, the collective’s internal dialogue in What We Said to Brussels Airlines poses a variety of questions and opens up space for critical reflection.

title: Tamashi
overview: In the desert of the Payahuunadü valley (the name means “land of flowing water”) of California, a father performs butoh for the first time in front of his former prodigy rock climber child. They speak to each other through their bodies to find a way to heal their relationship and the land.

title: You Do Not Exist
overview: In the stillness of his yard, Booker watches the sky fill and empty with passing planes. As the world moves around him, he lingers, circling a memory whose edges blur with time.

title: A Philological Quandary, Kenneth Anger’s ¡Que Viva Mexico!
original_title: A Philological Quandary, Kenneth Anger’s ¡Que Viva Mexico!
overview: Kenneth Anger edited his own version of Sergei Eisenstein’s unfinished Mexican reverie, and even showed it at a festival. Alas leaving no trace of the object. Bruce Posner, now, created his own multi-screen variation on the story that lyrically compares moments from ¡Que Viva Mexico! with scenes from Anger’s avant-garde axiom Scorpio Rising.

title: The Muscles Are Tense
overview: At a demonstration in Berlin against the genocide in Gaza and the German arms supplies contributing to it, protestors are violently arrested, wrestled to the ground, sprayed with pepper spray and captured on camera. This essay pauses those overwhelming moments and isolates what is happening in order to examine it. Drawing from Fanon and Butler, among others, it offers a pointed interrogation of double standards, the state’s monopoly on violence and protesting under constant surveillance.

title: See Through the Hollowed Blue Hellebore
original_title: See Through the Hollowed Blue Hellebore
overview: Beautiful images of southeastern Alaska’s majestic natural landscape drip, flow and take root in the accompaniment of the complex phonetic sounds of the indigenous Tlingit language and a lush sonic collage of local fauna. This landscape grows ever greener each year as the glaciers, like the language, begin to recede.

title: Welcome to Set
overview: Reenacting laboratory data collection processes, Welcome to Set invites you behind the scenes of machine learning, where data becomes drama. This experimental documentary explores how emotion, suspicion, and politics intertwine within the algorithmic practices of security.

title: The Next World
overview: A mother writes to her estranged child, but with each draft the details become fuzzy, threads are lost and the meaning erodes. A trip inside the memories of a mind in decline, grasping to finish the most critical thoughts and convey the most important sentiments imaginable.

title: I am a River
overview: Inspired by Pablo Neruda’s Book of Questions – a collection of lyrical, unanswerable poems written as paradoxical and playful interrogations of nature, life and the cosmos – this experimental miniature by Heidi Piironen weaves poetic inquiry with visual abstraction, through the rarely used mordançage technique. The veil-like formations it creates evoke the fluid, fragile, ever-changing essence of rivers, suggesting they are living entities, much like us.

title: Forget the Director, This Is Emmy’s Cut!
original_title: Forget the Director, This Is Emmy’s Cut!
overview: In Kampala’s cinema halls, VJ Emmy is the main event. The film follows this boisterous interlocutor as he brings the art of dubbing to life. Emmy doesn’t just translate; he performs, remixing blockbusters and cult classics with unfiltered commentary that renders them newly meaningful for local audiences.

title: The New Year's Resolution
overview: Following a brutal massacre on New Year's Eve, New York's most feared gang must prepare for war and face the consequences...

title: The End of The Punchline
overview: Set in 2011, we follow a trio of high school boys, Nick, Edd, and Viggo, as their senior year of high school comes to a halt when a secret kept by a shady government foundation is exposed, turning our heroes' worlds upside down.

title: Melania
overview: Offering unprecedented access to the 20 days leading up to the 2025 Presidential Inauguration — through the eyes of the First Lady-elect herself — step inside Melania Trump's world as she orchestrates inauguration plans, navigates the complexities of the White House transition, and reenters public life with her family. With exclusive footage capturing critical meetings, private conversations, and never-before-seen environments, Mrs. Trump returns to one of the world's most powerful roles.

title: Finding Goldfinger
overview: A coming-of-age historical fiction story about Pierre Joubert, a diver with depth recovery unit and the first recorded diver to salvage gold off the ship, The Birkenhead.

title: The Parking Garage
overview: One night, a second chance at his dream becomes a nightmare when a Kuwaiti man is haunted by his younger self and hunted by his self-doubt.

title: Crisis Actor
overview: Fired from her day job, an impulsive actress crashes a support group and spirals into a chaotic night that forces her to face her addiction to drama.

title: All About the Money
overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

title: Social Landscapes
overview: In a world where we often experience places on screens before we actually visit them, the film questions the fine line between perception and reality.

title: Together Forever
overview: A Mormon couple ties the knot.

title: Stinging Nettles
overview: In the midst of a city woodland, 16-year-old Iris explores her attraction to an older man. Their passion turns into a dangerous power play when Iris must indulge his cravings with a humiliating performance.

title: Zi
overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

title: Nuisance Bear
overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

title: The Metropolitan Opera: The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay
original_title: The Metropolitan Opera: The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay
overview: Added due to popular demand, the Met-premiere production of Mason Bates’s The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay arrives in cinemas, recorded live earlier this season. The exhilarating operatic adaptation of Michael Chabon’s Pulitzer Prize–winning novel follows two Jewish cousins who create a comic-book superhero, hoping to recruit America into the fight against Nazism. Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin conducts the dynamic new production by Tony Award–winning director Bartlett Sher.

title: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
overview: Now 93, Martin Luther King Jr.’s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider’s view of the Civil Rights Movement.

title: Still Standing
overview: On January 7, 2025, the Eaton fire destroyed over 9,000 structures in Altadena, California. Thousands more were left standing but contaminated with toxic ash. Residents face the impossible decision of whether they should risk their health to return home.

title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy
original_title: Going Sane: The Rise and Fall of the Center for Feeling Therapy
overview: A 1970s Los Angeles therapy collective rises with utopian promise before devolving into a business-minded cult built on control and abuse.

title: Flipper
overview: An upside-down car sits untouched for weeks on a quiet street dividing Lambeth and Southwark.

title: while the gods were busy with another child
original_title: while the gods were busy with another child
overview: This deeply exploratory work is drawn exclusively from the eclectic personal and public archive, in multiple formats, of Andrea’s life until their lasting estrangement from both parents, aged 30.

title: Liump! Heuriger
overview: Liump! Heuriger is the event bringing together a traditional Austrian pop-up wine tavern and a moth-watching set. The idea of inviting both people and insects to the same table is appealing for its simplicity, its naivety, and its likely failure.

title: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart
overview: Elizabeth Smart's harrowing abduction at 14 from her family's Utah home unfolds through her own words and never-before-seen material in this documentary.

title: Daniel
overview: Two pairs meet up at a restaurant, one for a date, the other for something more sinister.

title: Orpheus
overview: An adaptation of the myth, Orpheus.

title: Love on the Amazon
overview: Claire travels to Brazil and hires Danny, a riverboat captain, to help her deliver an important message for her sister Amelia, a marine biologist studying pink dolphins on the Amazon River.

title: Jerusalem '67
overview: In Jerusalem during the Six Day War, a young civilian leaves her family to serve her country; a man who abhors war must fight within sight of his home; and a group of paratroopers are dispatched to the city for a battle they never trained for.

title: Each, All and Every
overview: Trapped in the paradox of endless possibilities, Mr. Rabbit loses one choice by accident — and with it, his sense of freedom. What remains is an all-consuming fixation on the loss itself.

title: The Jolly Robbery
overview: On the night of Christmas Eve, two burglars break into a town home craving a sugary snack, but they didn't account for something.

title: Learning You
overview: When an architect embarks on a Christmas road trip with his autistic son, their journey of struggle and hope inspires a billionaire developer who has an autistic son of his own.

title: Killer Whale
overview: Follows best friends Maddie and Trish as they find themselves trapped in a remote lagoon with the dangerous killer whale named Ceto.

title: Between Me & You
overview: a one-reel experiment - part-'flicker film,' part-stop motion - shot on 16mm.

title: Vindicta
overview: In just one moment 19-year-old Hannah's world shatters when her parents are murdered in front of her. After fleeing, she seeks refuge with family friends before becoming the embodiment of rage and revenge towards those responsible for destroying her life. An unexpected connection with a handsome young Nazi Officer generates a moment of respite, but she is consumed by vengeance at any cost, no matter what or when. The story is inspired by the true events of women who helped defeat the Nazis during WWII.

title: The Trouble I See...
overview: Set inside the Richmond City Jail, The Trouble I See… follows two incarcerated fathers chosen to participate in a powerful father-daughter dance. Spanning five years, this deeply moving documentary explores generational cycles of incarceration, gun violence, and systemic inequality—while celebrating the unbreakable bonds of family, love, and resilience.

title: The Internship
overview: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.

title: Oscar Shaw
overview: After retiring from the police force, a relentless detective haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend sets out on a perilous quest for vengeance, seeking redemption and fighting to restore justice to the streets he once swore to protect.

title: Final Transmission
overview: Alone aboard a crippled transport drifting through deep space, Commander Elias Walker records what will become humanity’s final message. Earth is gone, and the ship, once a vessel of hope, now carries only failure and silence. As oxygen fades, Elias begins a calm mission log, clinging to duty and procedure. But as systems die around him, the truth surfaces: he isn’t just facing his own death, he’s witnessing the extinction of mankind.  In his final moments, the soldier becomes a storyteller, offering not a plea for rescue but a quiet eulogy for the human race. As the ship falls silent, his voice becomes the last echo of humanity, ending with a single, hopeful line:  “I hope the stars remember us.”

title: Elvis: A Life in Music
overview: A retrospective on the life of the legendary entertainer Elvis Presley, featuring the most significant moments of his career.

title: The Payback: A Bloodthirsty Story
overview: Taking place a year after Vlad's escapades in This Here Town, Gideon and Dick Focker are pit against each other by a new threat and a familiar face from beyond the grave...

title: Mirrored Heart
overview: After finding her mother’s old diaries as a New Year’s gift, Alev has to confront herself with her mother’s past while triggering a scar.

title: Bombshell
overview: Eighty years after the devastating atomic bombings that ushered in the nuclear age, Bombshell explores how the U.S. government manipulated the narrative about the atomic bombings of the Japanese cities Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Through propaganda, censorship and the co-opting of the press, the government presented a benevolent picture of atomic power, minimizing the horrific human toll. Bombshell sheds light on the efforts of a group of intrepid reporters to let the world know the truth.

title: Tribute to David Bowie - Heroes Never Die
overview: The Molotovs kick things off in style with “Rebel Rebel,” followed by magical covers of “Heroes” (The Horrors), ‘Fascination’ (La Roux), “Let's Dance” (Jeanne Added), “Rock'n'Roll Suicide” (The Libertines), “Sound and Vision” (Anna Calvi), “Starman” (The Divine Comedy), and “The Man Who Sold the World” (Yasmine Hamdan): eight intense reinterpretations of David Bowie's work, delivered during an arty and decidedly London-esque stroll, which, from stage to studio, recreates the fragile intensity of a live performance.

title: Wild London
overview: After a life spent travelling the globe, the world’s most famous naturalist turns his attention closer to home to explore the wildlife of England’s iconic capital. Having lived in London for 75 years, Sir David has an intimate knowledge of the city’s natural history, and there's no better guide to introduce us to its most spectacular wildlife secrets. Captured over his centennial year, this personal and poignant film is a timely insight into how cities can become homes for wildlife as well as ourselves.

title: Corrupted Pleasure
overview: A corrupted file seduces the viewer

title: Mirar y Aprovechar
overview: A visual and sonic stroll through a neighborhood in Valencia, in which the treasures of a flea market, the façades of buildings in ruins and the waves of a leisury shore, echo other times, other families and other shores.

title: NightBound
overview: Trevora Ramos is trapped in a nighttime time loop and can't escape the mysterious horror house that he is in. Various ghosts , ghouls and other vicious creatures lie in wait ready to torment Trevora and make him suffer. As he tries to find various ways to escape Trevora slowly realizes that he is NightBound to the house which means as long as its nighttime he can't escape.

title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
original_title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
overview: Ainsley McGregor thought craft markets and book clubs, not corpses, would define her new life back home in Sweet River. That is until a beloved member of the book club raises a cold case involving her late husband who was found murdered over his rare antique watch. Ainsley springs into action to untangle a web of small town secrets before the killer winds the clock down on the next victim.

title: Open Acting Studio Days Part: 2
overview: A live-recorded acting workshop demonstrating effective acting techniques and on-stage performance methods, hosted by Remo Vinzens

title: Oasis Bandung Live Forever
overview: Oasis Bandung Live Forever tells the story of the struggle of the Oasis Bandung Community to maintain its identity and unity since its inception, overcoming internal conflicts, a lack of activities, and the impact of the pandemic.  However, thanks to the solidarity of its members and small gigs that kept the spirit alive, they rose again with a new concept that expanded the community's influence. Despite another organizational crisis, sponsor support and the principle of “from the community, to the community” became the foundation that kept Oasis Bandung alive and beloved.

title: My Hero
overview: My Hero is an action thriller about coming out of your comfort zone. We follow the story of a loner, Nathan, who has been pushed around by life, and his only happiness is martial arts films. He built so many walls around his life that he can’t get out of a routine of a low-level cleaner job at a gym and lonely night-time binges on TV. Until he can’t have enough of his horrible life, he joins a human trial to become a better self. Not knowing what he signed up for is more than a friendly trial to help people. To make matters worse, Nathan is now accidentally involved with a criminal organisation, and he has no answer or defences. Until his alter ego - HERO, spawns out. But Hero, just like Nathan, is full of flaws and contradictions. And the two form an unlikely friendship where perhaps at the end, only one can survive. An action film for the new generation full of adrenaline, fights, emotions and martial arts.

title: Ronan Keating & Friends: A New Year’s Eve Party
original_title: Ronan Keating & Friends: A New Year’s Eve Party
overview: Get ready for the ultimate New Year’s Eve party as global music legend Ronan Keating takes centre stage to lead the celebrations into 2026. A night packed with incredible performances, big surprises, and feel-good hits as Ronan performs some of his greatest songs alongside a lineup of very special guests.

title: Mendocino
overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

title: Screw Year's Eve
overview: A group of friends decide to ring in the New Year at an extravagant 80s-themed party hosted in a remote warehouse at the edge of town. As the night unfolds, they quickly realize they are not alone. Trapped in a labyrinth of neon lights and retro nostalgia, they find themselves hunted by a merciless killer hell-bent on making sure they never see another year.

title: Samsa
overview: After a long and terrible journey, Nasìr arrives in Italy, where he has the chance to fulfill his big dream and be admitted to a prestigious cooking school. To do so, he will have to cook the most important dish of his life. A dish that, behind a recipe, tells a story.

title: Hi Mike (Re - Move yourself)
overview: Alessandro, the young heir to a powerful family, is obsessed with his ego and thirst for success. Every moment of his life is devoted to building a winning image, ready to overcome any obstacle. But on a hot summer day, fate presents him with a decisive test that will forever change the course of his life.

title: Scusa
overview: Diego and Gio', inseparable friends, face the battle against the disease that marks Gio's life, always finding a reason to joke. Amid laughter, and moments of deep closeness, they know their bond is facing the most painful farewell.

title: The Arrangement
overview: The Arrangement is a psychological horror short set entirely during a dinner party at a remote cabin. As the evening unfolds, subtle inconsistencies in behavior, time, and conversation suggest the gathering is following a predetermined design.

title: Dying for Living
overview: An aging hitman seeks redemption, gathering his assassin family amid mayhem and intrigue. As dark secrets unravel, loyalties shatter, blurring love and betrayal in an adrenaline-fueled tale where bullets fly and stakes are high.

title: Martyrion, Isabelle's Story
overview: On December 3, 2022, at just 20 years of age, Jean Paul Sofia died when he was crushed by rubble at a construction site in Kordin, Malta.  His mother, Isabelle Bonnici, began a long fight for justice, launching the second public inquiry in the history of the Maltese Republic.  She made her testimony even more powerful by deciding to pose for Martyrion, a photographic project that denounces environmental destruction and territorial abuse through the body and religious iconography.

title: Details Of Sadness
overview: a film by omid ghafari & amirhossein ghafari

title: Too Far, Too Late
overview: Morteza and his father are searching for medicine for his sick mother when Morteza learns she has passed away. His sister urges him to bring their father back to the hospital, but Morteza, unable to share the news, continues the search with his father. As they journey together, past conflicts and memories bring them closer, until Morteza finally finds a way to tell his father about their mother's death, drawing on a childhood memory of loss.

title: The Children are afraid
overview: Every year, Mylène, a teacher, faces challenges in her work. This year, it's little Axelle and her mother who are putting her through the wringer. Patience, firmness, and trust will guide the teacher in helping both the child and her mother feel secure - each of them having a heart much softer than they let on at first glance.

title: And Then There Was One
overview: In Lagos, two paths cross for a fleeting moment that could mean nothing—or everything.

title: Trancers: The Whole Dethly Affair
overview: Get ready for the ultimate "Trancers" experience with this newly re-edited "master cut" of Trancers 4 and Trancers 5, remixed into one mega movie! When the time-travelling TCL chamber goes haywire, perpetually surly supercop Jack Deth accidentally winds up in a deadly alternate dimension in which a new breed of the ghoulish Trancers have assumed complete control.

title: Beth McCarthy - The Hot & Stupid Tour Live from London
original_title: Beth McCarthy - The Hot & Stupid Tour Live from London
overview: A night with Beth McCarthy at her London headline show as part of “The Hot & Stupid Tour” in 2025

title: The Other Side of Goodbye
overview: A tireless man takes a walk one night, hoping to find answers to a problem that he has yet to fully understand.

title: [Untitled] - Ébauche
overview: a bleak winters day

title: Vittorio Angelone: Who Do You Think You Are? I Am!
original_title: Vittorio Angelone: Who Do You Think You Are? I Am!
overview: Vittorio Angelone's second stand-up comedy special, filmed on 21st May 2025 in Glasgow (which explains certain rounds of applause throughout). It is named after Pete Weber's viral bowling moment.

title: Wood Screw
overview: When the individual lifestyles of the embodiments of urban and nature meet... They clash, and create a new parasitic relationship.

title: Sancho
overview: Two friends attempt to adapt their competing visions of Don Quijote

title: The Gathering
overview: The value of Christmas tradition with family

title: 𐕣TAPE 1𐕣 - Why Does Jesus Hate Me?
original_title: 𐕣TAPE 1𐕣 - Why Does Jesus Hate Me?
overview: Experimental film about religious trauma and the damage that it will bring to peoples lives.

title: Silent Night
overview: After returning home from shopping, Belle is met with an early Christmas surprise when an intruder breaks into her home, knocks her unconscious, and ties her up. Belle now waits for her husband to return home to save her from this mysterious man.

title: The Motivator
overview: A Man having a mental breakdown and identity crisis because of the work, the stress of his wife and unboorn child, will he be able to bear all of it?

title: Disney Parks Magical Christmas Day Parade
original_title: Disney Parks Magical Christmas Day Parade
overview: A Christmas parade featuring musical performances.

title: Crisis At Dawn
overview: At the break of dawn, a covert operative is sent to recover a mysterious alien mineral with the power to change humanity. When his mission draws him into a deadly game with a brilliant and ruthless scientist, betrayal and danger lurk around every corner. He must fight to survive and protect the one person who has been with him through it all.

title: Shaun the Sheep: Fleece Navidad
overview: Shaun goes extra Christmassy for the background of the Farmer's Christmas card photo by secretly knitting festive jumpers to brighten it up.

title: Wild Beast
